intro: 1.7.1 is a round of care for 1.7, with two things you will see every day: your streak at the top of every tab, and a calendar made for your phone.

sections.heading: Your streak, in view
sections.body: A flame and your count now sit beside Premium on every tab, and a tap opens your streak. The flame grows the longer you keep it: Spark from the first day, Candle at seven days, Lamp at forty, Crown at a hundred, and All flame at a year. The last is named after Abba Joseph of Panephysis, who in the Sayings of the Desert Fathers told a brother that he could become all flame. Your streak sheet shows every flame, the ones you have reached, the next one with the days left, and the rest still to come. Your badges stay yours for good.

sections.heading: A calendar made for your phone
sections.body: The month fits the screen, and the arrows or a swipe turn it. Each day carries its fast and feast marks under its number, and the day you choose sits below: its fast, its saints with their icons, and its readings, each one opening the Bible. New and Old Calendar is one switch, and Today is one tap.

sections.heading: Finer everywhere
sections.body: The reading room's covers are posters, with every title whole at every size. Learn to Pray draws the Sign of the Cross, the hand and the four touches in their order. Remember the verse says what it is and lets you check yourself a word at a time. Search in the Bible has a screen of its own, holding on the words no longer covers the reading bar, chants say plainly when they can play, and pictures arrive calmly. On iPad the Bible and the Fathers sit in the middle of the screen.
